content.text: The verifier's substantive review again fully endorses the finding: status compliant, no redline, no comment, and the failed deterministic check acknowledged as a false signal. There is nothing substantive to repair, so I'll resubmit the same compliant finding, tightened.

input.quote: Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no Vendor-side audit, inspection, records-examination or verification right binding Mortgage Logic.com. Literal searches for "audit," "inspect," "records," "verif" and "monitor" return zero hits, and every provision in the areas where such a right would sit points the other way: § 6 (p0047) runs in Client's favour, entitling Client to documentation supporting amounts charged and to contest charges; § 3(e) (p0037) gives Client — not TrueLink — real-time access to Interface usage statistics and raw log files; § 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) contains only compliance, access-restriction and content warranties. The sole TrueLink self-help right, § 8(f) (p0058), permits TrueLink to implement technical mechanisms on its own hosted platform against spamming or illegal activity — platform policing, not an audit of Client's usage, and it confers no access to Client systems or records. § 9 obliges Client only to provide reasonable access for TrueLink's Y2K remediation at TrueLink's sole cost, which benefits us. Silence on audit rights is more favourable to us than the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, no system access), so "compliant" rather than "missing" is the correct classification and no redline or comment is warranted; the text is left unchanged. The failed deterministic "audit frequency limited" check is a false signal — a frequency-cap pattern cannot match where no audit clause exists at all — and does not evidence a deviation. Negotiation watch item only: resist any audit right TrueLink seeks to add; if one must be conceded, hold to the preferred parameters, with the fallback being annual audits on 15 days' notice at TrueLink's cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
